name: two counters list
code:
def counter():
    c = [0]
    def inc():
        c[0] += 1
        return c[0]
    return inc
f = counter()
g = counter()
print(f(), g(), f(), g())

name: two counters nonlocal int
code:
def counter():
    n = 0
    def inc():
        nonlocal n
        n += 1
        return n
    return inc
f = counter()
g = counter()
print(f(), g(), f(), g())
